evidence.detail: New export returns { delay, attemptsLeft } computed via retryDelay(attempt, 2, 'standard') and Math.max(0, 6 - Math.floor(attempt)). Previously not exported, so any pre-edit caller relying on a different signature/name would break; no tests guard the new policy.

Now destructures { delay, attemptsLeft } from retry.retryWindow(attempt) and concatenates 'delay:attemptsLeft'. The callers invariant block also shows a retryWindowLabel variant using retry.retryBudget(attempt, 2, 'urgent').remaining, suggesting duplicated/conflicting definitions whose relative ordering and which is live is ambiguous.
Budget of Math.max(0, 6 - Math.floor(attempt)) is a behavioral choice with no test assertion; Math.floor (not Math.ceil or round) is a subtle choice affecting boundary attempts.
Usage evidence shows the result is 'assigned to { delay, attemptsLeft }', which matches the new shape, so type/structural coupling is satisfied.
No tests cover retryWindow or retryWindowLabel, leaving the new contract unverified.
